Title: What to do after an escape of water at home
Body: 1. Turn off the water at the stopcock. 2. Turn off electricity at the consumer unit if water is near sockets or wiring. 3. Do not throw anything away, we may need to inspect damaged items. 4. Photograph the source of the leak and all affected rooms before you start clearing up. 5. Take reasonable steps to prevent further damage, for example moving furniture and lifting soft furnishings. 6. Call an approved restoration contractor from our network. 7. Report the claim with your policy number and the date you discovered the leak.

Title: How long a claim takes and what the stages mean
Body: Submitted: we have your notification and are opening the file, usually within 1 working day. Evidence Requested: we need something from you, such as a quote, receipt or photograph, and the claim will not progress until it arrives. Under Assessment: an assessor has everything needed and is reviewing, typically 5 working days. Approved Awaiting Payment: the decision is made and payment is scheduled, typically 3 working days to reach your account. Settled: payment has been sent. Declined: we could not cover the claim and you will have received a letter explaining why and how to appeal.

Title: What to do immediately after a motor accident
Body: If you have just had a car accident, a crash or any road collision involving your car, van or motorcycle, these are the steps to follow. 1. Check for injuries and call 999 if anyone is hurt. 2. Do not admit liability at the scene. 3. Exchange names, addresses, vehicle registrations and insurer details with the other driver. 4. Photograph both vehicles, the road position and any damage before moving. 5. Note the time, location and weather. 6. Report to Contoso Insurance within 48 hours, even if you do not intend to claim, so we can protect your position. You will need your policy number and the date of the incident.
